title: Be Careful What You Wish for ('Cause You Might Just Get It)
original_title: Be Careful What You Wish for ('Cause You Might Just Get It)
overview: A group of actors gathers to shoot a low-budget horror short, documenting the process mockumentary-style. When a sacred method-acting chant is invoked to "raise the stakes," the goth geeks unexpectedly gain metaphysical power.
